Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, we want to schedule a hands-on routing studio to walk through: prompt review, model selection for the POC, fallback rules, region tiering, and a short load rehearsal (low-concurrency). Proposed options:

- Option A: Tue, Mar 16 — 9:00–12:00 PT (half-day, focus on prompts + model tiering)
- Option B: Fri, Mar 19 — 13:00–16:00 PT (half-day, includes the planned load rehearsal)

Prework (attached): routing-studio-agenda.pdf — please skim. Also, if you can share a representative traffic profile (CSV) ahead of time that helps us scope the load run.

Can you confirm which slot works for you and whether your CTO or infra lead will join? We’ll assign leads from our side: Marissa will run the prompt workshop, Ben will own load choreography.

Best,
Karthik
